items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: He was the greatest thing that happened to me. Because he told me so much about music.

ctx.x: But we got somebody, Cab got somebody...

I don't remember... I was so busy trying to stay in that band, that I never remember when anybody got fired, what the reason was getting fired for. But that was a band. It was a fabulous band, a great band. Will Roziere(?) was our...
